वैकक्षं [विशेषेण कक्षति व्याप्नोति अण्]
1 A garland worn over one
shoulder and under the other like the
यज्ञोपवीत.
--2 An upper garment, a
mantle.

वैकक्षकं, वैकक्षिकं A garland worn
over the left shoulder and under
the right arm (like the यज्ञोपवीत q. v.).

वैकक्षकं, वैकक्षिकं A garland worn
over the left shoulder and under
the right arm (like the यज्ञोपवीत q. v.).

A butcher.
--2 A
particular part of the sacrificial
[]
victim.

वैकल्पिक a. (की f.) [विकल्पेन
प्राप्तः तत्र भवो वा ठक्]
1 Optional.
--2
Dubious, doubtful, uncertain,
undecided.

वैकल्यं [विकलस्य भावः ष्यञ्]
1
Defect, deficiency, imperfection.
--2 Mutilation, being crippled or
lame.
--3 Incompetency.
--4
Agitation, flurry, excitement.
--5
Nonexistence.
--6 Weakness, imbecility.

वैकारिक a. (की f.)
1
Relating to modification.
--2 Modifying.
--3 Modified.

वैकालिक a. (की f.), वैकालीन a.
(नी f.) Relating to or occurring
in the evening.

1 An epithet of Viṣṇu.
--2 Of Indra.
--3 Holy basil.
--ठं
1
The heaven of Viṣṇu.
--2 Talc.
--Comp.
--चतुर्दशी the fourteenth
day of the bright half of Kārtika.
--लोकः the world of Viṣṇu.

वैकृत a. (ती f.)
1 Changed.
--2
Modified.
--तं [विकृतस्य भावः अण्]
1
Change, alteration, modification.
--2
Aversion, disgust, loathing.
--3
Change in state, appearance &c.,
disfigurement;

.
--4 A
portent, any event foreboding evil;
तत्प्रतीपपवनादि वैकृतं प्रेक्ष्य

.
--Comp.
--विवर्तः a woeful^1 plight,
miserable condition, suffering;
वैकृतविवर्तदारुणः

.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210122. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48.

वैकृतिक a. (की f.)
1 Changed,
modified.
--2 Belonging to a Vikṛti
q. v. (in Sāṃkhya phil.).

1 Change, alteration.
--2
Woful state, miserable plight.
--3
Disgust.

वैक्लवं, वैक्लव्यं
1 Confusion,
agitation, bewilderment.
--2
Commotion, tumult.
--3 Affliction,
distress, grief; वैक्लव्यं मम तावदीदृशमपि
स्नेहादरण्यौकसः Ś. 4. 5,
